citation.authors: Jin X, Ruiz Beguerie J, Sze DM, Chan GC

cited_by.title: Lion's mane and reishi mushroom supplements

record.population: Cancer patients in five randomised trials of reishi (Ganoderma lucidum), mostly as an add-on to chemotherapy or radiotherapy
record.finding: Methodological quality was generally unsatisfying and reporting poor. People given reishi alongside chemotherapy or radiotherapy were more likely to respond than with the treatment alone (relative risk 1.50, 95% CI 0.90 to 2.51), and reishi on its own did not match that. No trial reported long-term survival, and adverse events were reported in only one study.
record.note: Cancer patients, not healthy people taking it for immunity. Quality poor.
